::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Internal reference. Not part of the published site; the `_design/` folder is excluded from the project render. Preview with `quarto render _design/design-system.qmd`.
:::

This is a working reference, not a brand guide. Every value here is taken from one of two sources: the Hub editor itself (`hub-client/src/theme.css` and component CSS in the `q2` repo) or quarto.org (`theme.scss`, `index.css` in `quarto-web`). Where the two disagreed, the editor won, because the goal is for this site to feel like the product.

`theme.scss` at the repo root implements everything below as a Quarto/Bootstrap theme.

## Principles

**Feels like the editor.** Light chrome, 1px borders, small tight type in UI elements, one accent color for the one action that matters.

**Quarto underneath.** Layout, callouts, code blocks, and navigation are stock Quarto so anything written here renders the same way it would in a Hub project.

**Borders, not shadows.** Panels and cards are separated by hairlines in `#d0d8e0`. Shadows are reserved for modals.

**One accent.** Indigo `#4f46e5` is used for the primary call to action and nothing else. Everything else is the Posit blue ramp.

## Typography

Both families are already loaded by the editor from Google Fonts.

::: {.type-sample}
<span class="eyebrow">Eyebrow · 11px · 700 · 1.5px tracking</span>
<div style="font-size:2.25rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-0.01em">Heading 1 · Open Sans 600</div>
<div style="font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;margin-top:.5rem">Heading 2 · Open Sans 600</div>
<div style="font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;margin-top:.5rem">Heading 3 · Open Sans 600</div>
<p style="margin-top:.75rem">Body · Open Sans 400 · 16px · line-height 1.6. Same `.qmd` files and YAML you already know, edited together in the browser with a live preview.</p>
<p class="mono" style="font-size:14px">code · Source Code Pro 400 · 14px · `format: revealjs`</p>
:::

| Role | Family | Size | Weight | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Body | Open Sans | 16px | 400 | line-height 1.6 |
| H1 / H2 / H3 | Open Sans | 36 / 25.6 / 19.2px | 600 | letter-spacing −0.01em |
| UI text | Open Sans | 13–14px | 500–600 | matches editor buttons and nav |
| Eyebrow label | Open Sans | 11px | 700 | uppercase, 1.5px tracking, Posit blue |
| Caption / meta | Open Sans | 12–13px | 400 | `#6a737b` |
| Code | Source Code Pro | 14px | 400 | on `#f5f5f5` |

: {.token-table}

The eyebrow (`PROJECT`, `DOCUMENT`, `FILES` in the editor) is the most recognizable Hub motif. Use it to label sections instead of adding another heading level.

## Shape and spacing

| Token | Value | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Radius, default | 6px | buttons, inputs, chips (36 uses in the editor) |
| Radius, large | 8px | cards, framed images |
| Radius, dialog | 12px | modals only |
| Border | 1px `#d0d8e0` | everywhere |
| Shadow | `0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.15)` | modals only |
| Header height | 36–44px | editor header is 36px; site navbar 44px |
| Transition | 0.15s | background, border, color |
| Content width | 1100px | matches quarto.org |

: {.token-table}

## Components

### Buttons

<p>
<a class="btn btn-primary" href="#">Open Hub</a>
<a class="btn btn-outline-secondary" href="#">How it works</a>
<a class="btn btn-dark" href="#">Preview</a>
</p>

Primary is indigo and appears once per view. Outline is the secondary action. Dark (`#213D4F`) mirrors the editor's Preview button and is for in-product references only.

### Status chip

<p><span class="chip">Available today</span> <span class="chip soon">Coming soon</span></p>

Modeled on the editor's "Synced" indicator. Green dot for shipped, amber for roadmap.

### Cards

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.hub-card}
<span class="eyebrow">Today</span>

### Card title
White, 1px border, 8px radius. Eyebrow, title, one or two sentences.
:::
::: {.hub-card .soon}
<span class="eyebrow">Coming soon</span>

### Roadmap card
Dashed border, transparent background. Same content pattern.
:::
:::

### Callouts

Stock Quarto callouts. They inherit the theme's colors without extra CSS.

::: {.callout-note}
Hub renders with the Quarto 2 engine. Some quarto-cli features are not available yet.
:::

### Framed screenshot

::: {.frame}
<div class="frame-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
<div style="height:120px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#7494B1;font-size:13px">screenshot goes here</div>
:::

A minimal browser frame so editor screenshots sit on the page without a hard edge.

## Dark mode

The editor ships a dark theme (`#1a1a2e` editor, `#16213e` chrome, `#646cff` accent). This site is light-only for now; when we add a toggle it should map to those values rather than a generic Bootstrap dark theme.

## Logo

There is no Hub mark yet. Until there is, use the Quarto icon (`images/quarto-icon.svg`) with "Quarto Hub" set in Open Sans 600.
